title: Rabbi Ilai bar Shemaya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 10:5, but the end of Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 22, reads Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon; Hyman reports the same reading in Pesikta de-Rav Kahana (supplied locator קס..).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Ilai bar Shemaya and Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon are the two reported name/father combinations. The 160a locator is historical pagination, not a newly assigned modern reference.

The whole Torat Emet Vayikra Rabbah 10:5 paragraph fully names Rabbi Ilai bar Shemaya; the selected whole Bereshit Rabbah 22:13 paragraph fully names Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon. Their distinct name and father combinations remain. The malformed supplied Pesikta locator קס.. is retained literally; the existing note’s 160a interpretation is historical commentary, not an established recovery of printed pagination or fresh Pesikta collation.
